description: The data of a mention of you or your team.

reason.description: Why you got it: mention or team_mention.

subject_type.description: The kind of thread: Issue, PullRequest, CheckSuite, Release, Discussion, or another kind.

number.description: The number of the issue or the pull request, when the thread has one.

url.description: The page of the thread or of its newest comment.

thread_id.description: The id of the GitHub notification thread.

updated_at.description: The time of the activity, in RFC 3339.
